templates.description: The most common layout with TopNav for app identity and SideNav for page-level navigation.

templates.name: AppShell — With Banner
templates.description: Full layout with TopNav, SideNav, and a dismissable info banner between the nav and content.

templates.name: AspectRatio — Circle Image
templates.description: Circular container via shape="ellipse" with ratio={1}, ideal for avatars and profile images.

templates.name: AspectRatio — Image Gallery
templates.description: Grid of images with consistent 4:3 aspect ratios.

templates.name: AspectRatio
templates.description: Three aspect ratio containers at equal height (1:1, 4:3, and 16:9), each showing an image with its ratio labeled below.

templates.name: AspectRatio — Square Image
templates.description: 1:1 square aspect ratio, ideal for avatars and Instagram-style images.

templates.name: AspectRatio — 16:9 Widescreen Image
templates.description: 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio wrapping an image.

templates.name: AspectRatio — Loading Skeleton
templates.description: Aspect ratio container with a skeleton loading placeholder.

templates.name: Avatar — Fallback Chain
templates.description: Demonstrates the avatar fallback chain: primary image, fallback image, initials, then default icon.

templates.name: Avatar — Group
templates.description: Overlap multiple avatars in a row to represent a group of people. Use for team lists, PR reviewers, or participant counts where you want to show faces without taking up much space.

templates.name: AvatarGroup — Interactive
templates.description: A facepile whose avatars link to profiles, with an overflow indicator that opens the full member list. The whole group is one Tab stop; arrow keys move between the avatars and the overflow button.

templates.name: AvatarGroupOverflow — Custom Text
templates.description: Provide short custom children such as 12+ when the overflow count needs compact product-specific formatting.

templates.name: AvatarGroupOverflow — Default Count
templates.description: Use AvatarGroupOverflow without children to render the standard +N overflow count.

templates.name: AvatarGroupOverflow
templates.description: Overflow indicators for hidden avatars, including the default +N label and custom count text.

templates.name: AvatarGroup
templates.description: Overlapping avatar rows with a sliced visible set and a server-side overflow count. Shows team members in a compact facepile layout.

templates.name: Avatar — Initials
templates.description: Show initials instead of a photo. The avatar extracts the first and last initials from the name automatically. Use when you only have a user name, like in anonymous accounts or new user onboarding.

templates.name: Avatar — Interactive
templates.description: Make an avatar interactive by passing `href` to render it as a link or `onClick` to render it as a button. Both forms are focusable and show a focus-visible ring for keyboard users. Use for profile links, mention pop-ups, or any avatar people can act on.

templates.name: Avatar
templates.description: Avatars at every size with an image, initials fallback, and a status dot. A quick visual reference for choosing the right size.

templates.name: AvatarStatusDot
templates.description: AvatarStatusDot renders a presence indicator on an Avatar, with variants for positive, neutral, and negative states. The dot size automatically coordinates with the Avatar size.

templates.name: AvatarStatusDot — Variants
templates.description: Presence dots on Avatars using the success, neutral, and error variants. Pass an AvatarStatusDot to the Avatar status prop; the dot sizes itself to match the Avatar.

templates.name: Avatar — Tooltip
templates.description: By default an avatar shows its name in a tooltip on hover and keyboard focus. Pass a string to show custom text instead, or false to turn the tooltip off.

templates.name: Avatar — User Card
templates.description: Place an avatar next to a name and role to create a user card row. Use for comment headers, contact lists, profile sections, or anywhere you need to identify a person at a glance.

templates.name: Avatar — Photo
templates.description: Show a profile photo at different sizes. Use when you have a user photo URL. If the image fails to load, initials are shown instead.

templates.name: Avatar — Status Dot
templates.description: Add a status dot to an avatar to show whether someone is online, away, or busy. Use in chat, messaging, or any UI where knowing availability matters.

templates.name: Badge — Colors
templates.description: Tag items with color-coded categories like teams, priorities, or topics. Use the 9 non-semantic color variants when you need to distinguish groups visually.

templates.name: Badge — Counts
templates.description: Show a number inside a badge for notification counts, unread messages, or task totals. Use next to icons, nav items, or list labels.

templates.name: Badge — Variants
templates.description: All semantic and color badge variants in a single view. Use semantic variants for status and color variants for categories.

templates.name: Badge — Status
templates.description: Show the state of an item like Active, Pending, or Failed. Use in table rows, list items, or detail pages where users need to see status at a glance.

templates.name: Banner — Collapsible
templates.description: Combine an action button, dismiss control, and a collapsible detail area in one banner. Children sit behind the toggle by default; `collapsible={{defaultIsOpen: true}}` starts it open, and `collapsible={false}` drops the toggle entirely. Use for complex notifications like config changes or deployment summaries.

templates.name: Banner — Dismiss
templates.description: Let the user close a banner after reading it. Use for maintenance notices, feature tips, or any non-critical message the user can acknowledge.

templates.name: Banner — Floating
templates.description: A floating banner raised with `elevation="med"`. Banners are inline by default; raise one when it should read as an overlay above content.

templates.name: Banner — Full Width
templates.description: A full-width banner with no border radius for page-level notifications. Use at the top of a page for site-wide announcements or maintenance alerts.

templates.name: Banner — Statuses
templates.description: All four status banners stacked: info, success, warning, and error. A quick visual reference for choosing the right status.

templates.name: Banner — Statuses
templates.description: All 4 banner statuses: info, success, warning, and error. Use to show persistent messages like updates, confirmations, cautions, or problems at the top of a page or section.

templates.name: Banner — Action
templates.description: Add a button to a banner so the user can act on the message. Use for trial expirations, payment failures, or anything that needs a response.

templates.name: BaseTypeahead — Custom Search Bar
templates.description: BaseTypeahead embedded inside a custom-styled wrapper. The wrapper provides its own border and icon chrome; anchorRef positions the dropdown relative to it. Use this pattern when Typeahead's built-in field layout does not fit your composition.

templates.name: BaseTypeahead
templates.description: A custom result renderer that adds supporting metadata while BaseTypeahead retains option semantics and keyboard behavior.

templates.name: Blank
templates.description: Bare scaffold: one heading slot, one empty content region, no navigation and no chrome. The starting point when every other layout imposes more structure than wanted.

templates.name: Blockquote — Showcase
templates.description: Blockquote with and without citation. A quick visual reference for the blockquote component.

templates.name: Blockquote — Testimonials
templates.description: Multiple quotes arranged in a card grid for a testimonials section. Combine with Card and Grid to create social-proof layouts.

templates.name: Blockquote — With Attribution
templates.description: A plain quote and a quote with a cite attribution. Use cite to credit the original author or source.

templates.name: Bottom Sheet — Height variants
templates.description: Compares hug, capped, and tall starting heights for different amounts of content.

templates.name: Bottom Sheet — Mobile keyboard
templates.description: Uses a tall, scrollable form that keeps focused controls visible above the mobile keyboard.

templates.name: Bottom Sheet — No scrim
templates.description: Keeps the page visible and interactive behind a non-modal bottom sheet.

templates.name: Bottom Sheet
templates.description: A mobile filter surface that rises from the bottom edge.

templates.name: Bottom Sheet — Snap points
templates.description: Drag-to-resize stops: a half-height working surface, and a peek that slides away and thins the scrim.

templates.name: Bottom Sheet — Review flow
templates.description: A two-step form flow of two standalone sheets driven by one state value: Continue replaces the review step with the confirmation in place, and Back returns.

templates.name: Bottom Sheet — Multi-step flow
templates.description: A three-step flow of standalone sheets of different heights, driven by one state value: moving on replaces the open step in place. This is the replacement for the deprecated BottomSheetSwitcher.

templates.name: BreadcrumbItem — Basic
templates.description: Breadcrumb links inside a Breadcrumbs trail. Ancestor pages get an href; mark the last item with isCurrent to render it as plain text for the current page.

templates.name: BreadcrumbItem
templates.description: BreadcrumbItem represents a single step in a breadcrumb trail, supporting links, icons, current-page markers, and custom link components.

templates.name: Breadcrumbs — Separators
templates.description: Swap the default "/" for a different character like chevrons, arrows, or dots. Use when the visual style of the page calls for a different separator.

templates.name: Breadcrumbs — Deep Path
templates.description: A 5-level breadcrumb trail for deeply nested content. Use in e-commerce, file browsers, or any UI with several levels of hierarchy.

templates.name: Breadcrumbs — Menu item
templates.description: Give a mid-trail crumb a `menu` prop to turn it into a menu trigger for switching between sibling destinations. It reuses the same item API as DropdownMenu, so an existing option array (or composed item children) drops in verbatim.

templates.name: Breadcrumbs
templates.description: A breadcrumb trail showing page hierarchy with linked ancestors and a current page.

templates.name: Breadcrumbs — Variants
templates.description: Compare the default and supporting variants side by side. Use the supporting variant in dense UIs like admin panels where the breadcrumb should be subtle.

templates.name: Breadcrumbs — Icons
templates.description: Add icons before breadcrumb labels for quick recognition. Use a home icon on the root item and contextual icons on key sections.

templates.name: Button — Floating
templates.description: A floating action button raised with `elevation="med"`. Use elevation for buttons that hover above content, like a FAB.

templates.name: ButtonGroup — Basic
templates.description: Three related actions joined into a single connected control. Provide a group label for accessibility and keep all buttons the same variant so they read as one unit.

templates.name: ButtonGroup — Floating
templates.description: A grouped action bar raised with `elevation="med"`. The connected buttons share one surface, so the shadow lifts them as a unit.

templates.name: Button — Variants
templates.description: All four button variants side by side: primary, secondary, ghost, and destructive. A quick visual reference for choosing the right variant.

templates.name: Button — Sizes
templates.description: Small, medium, and large buttons side by side. Use small in dense UIs like toolbars, medium for most cases, and large for prominent CTAs.

templates.name: Button — Variants
templates.description: All 4 button variants in default, disabled, and loading states. Use primary for the main action, secondary for most others, ghost for low-emphasis, and destructive for dangerous actions.

templates.name: Button — End Slot
templates.description: Buttons with a trailing badge showing a count or status. Use for notification counts, unread messages, or any button that needs a visual indicator.

templates.name: Button — Icon
templates.description: Buttons with a leading icon that reinforces the label. Use when the icon helps the user identify the action faster, like a plus for "New" or a trash can for "Delete".

templates.name: Calendar — Constraints
templates.description: Limit which dates can be selected using min/max bounds and custom rules like weekdays only. Use for scheduling UIs where certain dates are unavailable.

templates.name: Calendar — Range
templates.description: Pick a start and end date with the range highlighted between them. Use for booking dates, time-off requests, or report filters.

templates.name: Calendar
templates.description: An interactive single-date calendar with a selected date. Click any day to change the selection.

templates.name: Calendar — Single
templates.description: Pick one date from a month grid. Use for appointment dates, due dates, or any field that needs a single date.

templates.name: Calendar — Two Months
templates.description: Two months side by side for selecting ranges that span a month boundary. Use in booking or travel UIs where check-in and check-out often fall in different months.

templates.name: Canvas Editor
templates.description: Layered artboard workspace: document tabs over a layer rail, a fixed-size frame you zoom on a muted backdrop, and an inspector of position, type, and filter fields that retargets to the selected layer. Objects hold a coordinate rather than reflowing, so moving one never moves another.

templates.name: Card — Callout
templates.description: Muted-variant cards for tips, notes, or supplementary information. Use when content should be visually distinct but not prominent. The muted variant uses a wash background instead of the elevated default, making it feel recessed rather than raised. Works well in sidebars, help panels, or inline callouts.

templates.name: Card — Elevations
templates.description: The four elevation levels side by side. Cards are flat by default; raise a card with `elevation` only when it needs to float above surrounding content.

templates.name: Card
templates.description: A card with a heading and body text showing the default container style.

templates.name: Card — Variants
templates.description: Default, muted, and color variants side by side. Use color variants to categorize cards visually, like team colors, project tags, or content types. Each color uses the corresponding background token from the theme, so they adapt to light and dark mode automatically.

templates.name: Card — Layout
templates.description: A card with a structured header, content area, and footer with action buttons. Use for forms, dialogs, or settings panels that need clear sections. Pair Card with Layout to get automatic dividers between header, content, and footer. The footer aligns actions to the right by default.

templates.name: Card — Simple
templates.description: A card with a heading and body text. Use for summaries, descriptions, or any grouped content that needs visual separation from the page. The card handles its own border, background, and padding; just pass your content as children. Set a width to constrain it, or leave it to fill the parent.

templates.name: Carousel — Cards
templates.description: A horizontally scrollable row of cards with snap scrolling enabled. Use for feature grids, product lists, or any set of cards that overflows the available width. The carousel adds fade edges and navigation buttons automatically.

templates.name: Carousel
templates.description: A horizontal carousel of cards with scroll-snap and navigation buttons. Scroll or click the arrows to browse.

templates.name: Carousel — Snap
templates.description: Scroll-snap carousel with navigation buttons and team member cards. Each card snaps to the start edge on scroll. Use when items should be viewed one at a time rather than as a continuous strip.

templates.name: Centered Hero
templates.description: Symmetrical centered stack (headline, short blurb, paired call-to-action buttons) resting on one wide full-bleed picture, with nothing on either flank competing.

templates.name: Center — Horizontal Center
templates.description: A formatting control group centered with axis="horizontal" in the default horizontal writing mode. In other writing modes, Center currently follows the flex main axis rather than guaranteeing physical horizontal centering.

templates.name: Center — Vertical & Horizontal Center
templates.description: An empty state with an icon, heading, and description centered both vertically and horizontally inside a card. This is the most common use of Center: placing content in the middle of a fixed-height area like a panel, card, or content region. The height prop defines the centering space.

templates.name: Center
templates.description: Content centered horizontally and vertically inside a fixed-height container.

templates.name: ChatComposer — Attachments
templates.description: Chat composer with removable file tokens in a collapsible drawer. Use when users can attach files or context to their message.

templates.name: ChatComposerDrawer — Attachments
templates.description: Drawer with two rows: a scrollable carousel of image thumbnails and a row of removable file tokens. Omit count to keep the drawer always expanded.

templates.name: ChatComposerDrawer — Collapsible
templates.description: Drawer with many items and a collapse toggle. Pass count to enable the toggle; collapsed state shows a badge with the total count and a label.

templates.name: ChatComposerDrawer — Feedback
templates.description: Chat composer drawer with a feedback prompt and selectable lettered options. Use for user confirmation workflows that require explicit action before proceeding.

templates.name: ChatComposerDrawer
templates.description: Composer drawer with file tokens, a collapsible toggle, and header actions. Use as a starting point for any chat composer with attachments.

templates.name: ChatComposerDrawer — With Progress
templates.description: Drawer paired with a context progress bar in the header. Show context window usage when attachments consume part of the available token budget.

templates.name: ChatComposer — Flat
templates.description: The composer is raised by default (`elevation="low"`). Set `elevation="none"` to flatten it; it then draws a border with the same rest / hover / focus treatment as a text input.

templates.name: ChatComposer — Footer Actions
templates.description: Chat composer with dropdown menus for a model selector and settings in the footer, and a mic button in the send actions slot.

templates.name: ChatComposer — Full Featured
templates.description: Chat composer with all slots populated: collapsible attachment drawer, header actions, context progress bar, footer dropdown menus, and mic button. Shows the maximum composer configuration.

templates.name: ChatComposerInput — Controlled
templates.description: Controlled chat input with live value display. Use controlled mode when you need to read or transform the input value outside the composer.

templates.name: ChatComposerInput — Disabled
templates.description: Composer in a disabled state. Use when the input should be visible but not interactive, such as during streaming or when a prerequisite is unmet.

templates.name: ChatComposerInput — Mentions
templates.description: Chat input with an @ trigger that opens a typeahead menu for mentioning users. Selected names appear as inline tokens.

templates.name: ChatComposerInput — Multiple Triggers
templates.description: Chat input with both @ mentions and / commands. Each trigger type renders tokens in a distinct color so users can tell them apart at a glance.

templates.name: ChatComposerInput — Slash Commands
templates.description: Chat input with a / trigger for command selection. Use for AI assistants or bots that support structured commands.

templates.name: ChatComposer — Simple
templates.description: Minimal chat composer with a placeholder and submit handler. The simplest way to drop a message input into a page.

templates.name: ChatComposer — Streaming
templates.description: Chat composer with streaming state and a stop button. Use when the assistant is generating a response and the user can cancel.

templates.name: ChatComposer — Validation
templates.description: Chat composer with error and warning status messages. Status can appear above or below the composer to surface validation or system feedback.

templates.name: ChatDictationButton — Basic
templates.description: A dictation button wired to useChatDictation and placed in the sendActions slot of a ChatComposer. Click the microphone to transcribe speech into the input.

templates.name: ChatDictationButton
templates.description: Interactive dictation button connected to the SpeechRecognition API via useChatDictation. Click the mic to dictate into the composer.

templates.name: ChatDictationButton — In Composer
templates.description: Dictation button placed in the sendActions slot of a chat composer. Shows the recommended integration point for voice input alongside the send button.

templates.name: ChatDictationButton — States
templates.description: Dictation button in idle, listening, and speaking states side by side. Shows the three visual phases of a voice input interaction.

templates.name: ChatDictationButton — Sizes
templates.description: Small and medium dictation buttons side by side. Use small in compact composer densities and medium for standard layouts.

templates.name: ChatLayout — Panel View
templates.description: Narrow sidebar chat in a constrained container that triggers compact density. Use for side panels, drawers, or embedded chat widgets where horizontal space is limited.

templates.name: ChatLayoutScrollButton — Labels
templates.description: Scroll button with different labels for context-specific notifications like new messages, unread replies, or a generic scroll prompt.

templates.name: ChatLayoutScrollButton
templates.description: Scroll button in hidden, visible, and expanded (with label) states. The button fades in when the user scrolls up and expands when new messages arrive.

templates.name: ChatMessage — Avatar & Name
templates.description: Messages with avatars and sender names. Place the name on the bubble when using bubbles, or on the message wrapper for raw content.

templates.name: ChatMessageBubble — Custom Content
templates.description: Custom in-message content aligned to the bubble text column. An artifact card is wrapped in a ghost bubble with width="100%", so its left edge matches the bubble text and it spans the full message column instead of the default bubble width cap; the timestamp rides the bubble metadata slot.

templates.name: ChatMessageBubble — Density
templates.description: Compact, balanced, and spacious density modes side by side. Density controls bubble padding, corner radius, and spacing between grouped bubbles.

templates.name: ChatMessageBubble — Grouping
templates.description: Multi-bubble messages using first, middle, and last group positions. Grouped bubbles tighten corner radius on the sender side for a continuous visual flow.

templates.name: ChatMessageBubble — Metadata
templates.description: Bubbles with name and metadata slots aligned to bubble padding. Put name on the first bubble and metadata on the last bubble in a message.

templates.name: ChatMessageBubble
templates.description: Grouped user bubbles with filled styling and a ghost-variant agent response, with timestamps and delivery status.

templates.name: ChatMessageBubble — Variants
templates.description: Filled and ghost bubble variants for both user and assistant senders. Use filled for standard messages and ghost when content needs alignment without a visual boundary.

templates.name: ChatMessage — Ghost
templates.description: Ghost variant for messages without visible bubble boundaries. Keeps padding for alignment but renders a transparent background, useful for AI-style responses.

templates.name: ChatMessageList — Density
templates.description: Side-by-side comparison of compact, balanced, and spacious densities. Use compact in sidebars or panels, balanced for most full-page chat, and spacious for long-form reading. Use gap when row spacing needs to differ from density.

templates.name: ChatMessageList — Full Featured
templates.description: Conversation showcasing system messages, multi-bubble grouping, markdown, code blocks, and metadata. Combines date dividers, ghost bubbles, grouped messages, and rich content in a single example.

templates.name: ChatMessageList
templates.description: Basic AI chat conversation with user and assistant messages. The simplest way to render a message list with alternating sender bubbles, metadata, and a date divider.

templates.name: ChatMessageMetadata — Footer Actions
templates.description: Assistant message with footer actions: copy, retry, thumbs up/down, and model label. Use for AI responses that need feedback or utility controls.

templates.name: ChatMessageMetadata
templates.description: Three-message conversation showcasing error status with retry, delivery status, and full footer actions with model label.

templates.name: ChatMessageMetadata — Status
templates.description: All 5 delivery statuses (sending, sent, delivered, read, and error), each with a timestamp. Use to show message delivery progress or surface failures.

templates.name: ChatMessageMetadata — Timestamps
templates.description: Timestamp-only metadata on user and assistant messages. Supports absolute time and relative formats via Timestamp.

templates.name: ChatMessage — Multi-Bubble
templates.description: Grouped bubbles using the group prop for corner radius reduction. Use first, middle, and last to visually connect related bubbles from the same sender.

templates.name: ChatMessage
templates.description: A user multi-bubble group with delivery status and an assistant ghost response with avatar, name, timestamp, and model info.

templates.name: ChatSendButton — Custom Icon
templates.description: Send buttons with custom icons via sendIcon and stopIcon props. Use to match the personality of the chat experience: a paper airplane for messaging, sparkles for AI generation, or a check mark for confirmation flows.

templates.name: ChatSendButton — In Composer
templates.description: Send button inside ChatComposer, where it reads state from context automatically. No wiring needed; the button enables when the input has content.

templates.name: ChatSendButton
templates.description: Ready, custom icon, and streaming states of the send button.

templates.name: ChatSendButton — States
templates.description: Disabled, ready, and streaming states at both sizes. The button automatically toggles between send (primary) and stop (secondary) based on streaming state.

templates.name: ChatSystemMessage
templates.description: System messages for date dividers, status updates, and informational notices. Shows both default and divider variants in a realistic conversation flow.

templates.name: ChatSystemMessage — Status Updates
templates.description: Realistic status messages in a conversation flow showing membership changes, timestamps, and resolution notices.

templates.name: ChatSystemMessage — Variants
templates.description: Default and divider variants side by side. Use default for inline status updates and divider for date separators or section breaks.

templates.name: ChatSystemMessage — Icon
templates.description: System messages with a leading icon that reinforces the message type. Use icons to help users scan and identify message categories at a glance.

templates.name: ChatTokenizedText — Basic
templates.description: A message with @mention tokens. Each matching pattern is replaced with its display name badge.

templates.name: ChatTokenizedText — Colors
templates.description: Tokens with different color variants to distinguish mentions, bugs, and features. Use variant colors to create a visual taxonomy: blue for people, red for bugs, green for features.

templates.name: ChatToolCalls — Expandable
templates.description: Tool calls with expandable result details showing diffs and command output in code blocks. Click a row to reveal its result.

templates.name: ChatToolCalls — Statuses
templates.description: All four status states (pending, running, complete, and error) shown together in a single group.

templates.name: ChatToolCalls — Simple
templates.description: A single inline tool call above a collapsible multi-call group with diff stats. Shows both layouts side by side.

templates.name: CheckboxInput — States
templates.description: Checkboxes with labels and descriptions in checked, unchecked, and disabled states. Each checkbox controls a single on/off setting. Add a description to explain what the setting does.

templates.name: CheckboxInput — Indeterminate
templates.description: A "select all" checkbox that controls a group of options. When only some options are checked, it shows a dash instead of a checkmark. Clicking it checks or unchecks everything.

templates.name: CheckboxInput
templates.description: Interactive checkboxes showing checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states with descriptions.

templates.name: CheckboxInput — Status
templates.description: Checkboxes with error, warning, and success validation messages. Use the status prop to show feedback after form validation: errors block submission, warnings inform, and success confirms.

templates.name: CheckboxListItem — Basic
templates.description: Checkbox items with labels and descriptions inside a controlled CheckboxList. Use for multi-select option groups like notification preferences.

templates.name: CheckboxListItem
templates.description: Checkbox list items with labels, descriptions, and different states including disabled.

templates.name: CheckboxList — Select All With Indeterminate
templates.description: A "select all" toggle at the top of a checkbox list that switches to an indeterminate dash when only some items are checked, useful for bulk actions like exporting documents or assigning permissions where users often want everything at once.

templates.name: CheckboxList — With End Content
templates.description: Badges in the trailing slot show contextual info, like a price or status, next to each option without cluttering the label, so users can compare choices at a glance.

templates.name: Checkout Wizard
templates.description: Multi-step checkout, cart, order, and payment wizard with a running summary that recalculates as answers change. It adapts to its host width, renders the summary first on narrow surfaces, validates every forward path, and completes locally without sending payment.

templates.name: Citation — Inline Text
templates.description: Citations embedded within a paragraph of text, showing how they flow inline with surrounding content.

templates.name: Citation — Showcase
templates.description: All citation variants at a glance: label chips and numbered badges, with and without icons and links.

templates.name: Citation — Source List
templates.description: A list of citation sources with icons, as you might show at the end of an AI-generated response or article footer.

templates.name: Classic Gallery
templates.description: Uniform grid of equal-ratio media tiles under a centered intro, with filter tabs that narrow the set in place. Regular rhythm, unlike the variable-height masonry variant.

templates.name: ClickableCard — Elevated
templates.description: A clickable card raised with `elevation="med"` so the shadow signals the whole surface is interactive.

templates.name: ClickableCard
templates.description: A clickable card that navigates on click. Nested interactive elements work independently.

templates.name: ClickableCardWithNestedButton
templates.description: A product card that navigates on click but has an independent "Add to cart" button inside.

templates.name: Code — Text Sizes
templates.description: Inline code rendered inside heading, body, supporting, and label text. Code automatically matches the font size of its parent text element.

templates.name: Code — Snippet
templates.description: Short terminal commands with no header: the copy button sits in its own column beside the code, so a one-line command reads as a single row and a long line ends before the button instead of running under it. Use for install instructions or one-liner commands that readers will paste directly.

templates.name: Code — Highlighted
templates.description: TypeScript code with specific lines highlighted to draw attention to a key section. Use highlightLines to call out new or important code in tutorials and changelogs.

templates.name: Code — Config
templates.description: A JSON configuration file with a title bar and line numbers. The title prop adds a filename label in the header so readers know which file the code belongs to.

templates.name: Code — Scrollable
templates.description: A long code block with a max height that enables vertical scrolling. Use maxHeight to keep the block from dominating the page when displaying large files.

templates.name: CodeBlock
templates.description: A syntax-highlighted TypeScript code block with line numbers, a title bar, and a copy button.

templates.name: Code — Terminal
templates.description: A dark terminal-style command block: a bash CodeBlock wrapped in SyntaxTheme with the GitHub Dark preset, copy button on, and no line numbers. Use for shell sessions or CLI output that should read as a terminal even on light pages. Reach for a dark syntax preset instead of hand-rolling a dark box with custom CSS.

templates.name: Code — Inline
templates.description: Inline code references mixed within a paragraph of body text. Use Code to mark up function names, hooks, or API terms so they stand out from surrounding prose.

templates.name: Code
templates.description: Inline code snippets inside a sentence showing how Code renders alongside body text.

templates.name: Code — Content Types
templates.description: Inline code used for variables, terminal commands, CSS properties, file paths, and keyboard shortcuts. Shows how Code adapts to different kinds of technical content.

templates.name: Collapsible — Controlled
templates.description: Manage the open section from parent state, so something other than a click can move it: a URL parameter, a form jumping to the step that failed validation, or the Previous/Next controls shown here. onChange hands back the whole open value.

templates.name: Collapsible — FAQ
templates.description: FAQ built with hasDividers: row hairlines and density padding with no custom CSS. Questions set their own type — body at semibold, not the trigger's default 17px large — so a list of questions reads as rows rather than a stack of headings, and question and answer separate on weight and color instead of size.

templates.name: CollapsibleGroup — Density
templates.description: density sets the block padding on every row in the group, so a list of sections can be tuned to the surface it sits on without touching the rows. compact for dense surfaces like sidebars and inspectors, balanced (the default) for page content, spacious for a short list that is the main thing on the page. It follows Table's scale and pairs with hasDividers, which turns it on at balanced.

templates.name: CollapsibleGroup
templates.description: CollapsibleGroup coordinates its Collapsible children: with type="single", opening one closes the others. No state or handlers in the example — the group owns which value is open and each child only declares its own. One Collapsible per Card, so each trigger keeps its default large type as the heading of its own surface.

templates.name: useCollapsible — Custom Disclosure
templates.description: Custom disclosure UI built directly with useCollapsible for headless open/close state.

templates.name: Collapsible — Multiple Mode
templates.description: Several sections open at once, for comparing across them — feature lists, pricing tiers. One Collapsible per Card, so each trigger keeps its own large type: it is the heading of its surface, not a row in a list.

templates.name: Collapsible
templates.description: An accordion group with three collapsible sections in single mode: opening one closes the others.

templates.name: Collapsible — Single Mode
templates.description: Only one section open at a time, so a single body of content competes for attention. Use defaultValue to pre-expand whichever section a first-time reader needs. Each Collapsible owns a Section, so its trigger is that section heading.

templates.name: Collapsible — With Dividers
templates.description: A flat list on the page background with hand-placed Dividers, for detail panels and sidebars where cards would add too much weight. Rows, so the triggers step down to body-semibold and a supporting metadata line sits under each answer.

templates.name: useTableColumnResize — Draggable Columns
templates.description: A Table using useTableColumnResize. Drag the right edge of any column header to resize; widths are committed on release. The last proportional column flexes to fill remaining space.

templates.name: CommandPalette — Async Search
templates.description: Server-side search with loading spinner and custom empty states.

templates.name: CommandPalette — Grouped
templates.description: Command palette with items grouped via auxiliaryData.group.

templates.name: CommandPalette — Custom Footer
templates.description: Command palette with a custom footer tip message.

templates.name: CommandPaletteEmpty — Basic
templates.description: A command palette with no results, showing a custom empty message via emptyBootstrapText. Use to explain why the palette is empty and what the user can do next.

templates.name: CommandPaletteEmpty
templates.description: Command palette empty state shown when no commands are available.

templates.name: CommandPaletteFooter — Basic
templates.description: A command palette footer with no children, rendering the built-in keyboard navigation hints. Use CommandPaletteFooter without content to get the default arrow-key, Enter, and Esc hints below the results list.

templates.name: CommandPaletteFooter
templates.description: Command palette footer with custom tip content.

templates.name: CommandPaletteGroup — Basic
templates.description: Command palette items organized under group headings using the composed CommandPaletteGroup form. Use to separate related commands into labeled sections.

templates.name: CommandPaletteGroup
templates.description: Command palette groups in both data-driven (auxiliaryData.group) and composed (CommandPaletteGroup + CommandPaletteItem) forms.

templates.name: CommandPaletteInput — With End Content
templates.description: Custom placeholder and a keyboard shortcut badge in the trailing slot via endContent.

templates.name: CommandPaletteInput
templates.description: Command palette search input with a custom placeholder and a keyboard shortcut hint in the endContent slot.

templates.name: CommandPaletteItem — Basic
templates.description: Selectable command palette items inside a CommandPaletteList, including highlighted and disabled states. Use when composing a palette manually instead of a search source.

templates.name: CommandPaletteItem
templates.description: An inline command palette whose items pair each command label with its keyboard shortcut through renderItem.

templates.name: CommandPaletteList — Item States
templates.description: Flat list showing the highlighted, selected, and disabled item states. Use CommandPaletteGroup to add section headings.

templates.name: CommandPaletteList
templates.description: Scrollable command palette list with grouped items, including a highlighted item, composed without a full CommandPalette.

templates.name: CommandPalette — Picker Mode
templates.description: Single-value picker with persistent selection and check indicator.

templates.name: CommandPalette — Rich Items
templates.description: Custom item rendering with icons, keyboard shortcuts, and keyword search.

templates.name: CommandPalette
templates.description: Basic command palette with static items and keyboard navigation.

templates.name: ComplexSelector — Deadline Picker
templates.description: A multi-step deadline field: pick a preset like Today or Next week, or switch to a custom date and time before applying. The popup stays open until the user commits, so the content owns the Apply action.

templates.name: ComplexSelector
templates.description: A two-axis picker: choose a fruit and a ripeness level from one control. ComplexSelector owns the trigger, popover, and focus restore while the custom grid owns its keyboard semantics.

templates.name: ComplexSelector — Tree Search
templates.description: A destination picker that combines a search field with a TreeList hierarchy. TreeList owns tree keyboard navigation; ComplexSelector owns the trigger, popover, and focus restore. Selecting a folder closes the popup.

templates.name: Contact Form
templates.description: Flat single-column form mixing control types (text, pill toggles, dropdowns, long free-text) landing on one full-width submit. No steps, no branching, no summary rail.

templates.name: ContextMenu — Basic
templates.description: An adaptive context area: long-press opens a BottomSheet on compact touch screens, while right-click opens a cursor-positioned menu elsewhere.

templates.name: ContextMenu — Bottom Sheet
templates.description: A ContextMenu using the explicit BottomSheet presentation. Long-press the target on touch devices or right-click it with a pointer. Keep a visible menu trigger for important mobile actions.

templates.name: ContextMenuItem — Basic
templates.description: Context menu items with labels and secondary descriptions. Use ContextMenuItem to render custom menu entries with consistent styling.

templates.name: ContextMenuItem
templates.description: Context menu with custom-rendered items using ContextMenuItem for icons and descriptions.

templates.name: ContextMenu
templates.description: An adaptive context area that supports long-press on compact touch screens and right-click elsewhere.

templates.name: Analytics Dashboard
templates.description: Three-band analytics: a row of headline tiles, then charts, then supporting tables, all re-reading from one global filter bar. Breadth over depth, a summary surface rather than a drill-down.

templates.name: Service Monitoring Dashboard
templates.description: Always-on analytics with a triage rail: status-colored tiles with sparklines, multi-series time charts over a switchable window, and an independently scrolling alert column that folds into the content when narrow.

templates.name: Funnel & Cohort Dashboard
templates.description: Analytics for sequence and retention questions, pairing two shapes a plain dashboard cannot hold: a staged funnel where each step reads as drop-off against the one before, and a two-axis cohort matrix rendered as a heatmap.

templates.name: Data Dashboard
templates.description: Comparison-heavy analytics behind a persistent filter bar: tiles that each carry an inline sparkline and several period-over-period deltas, then segmented breakdowns underneath. Every number is shown against another number.

templates.name: Portfolio Dashboard
templates.description: Analytics for a value-over-time question: balance and change tiles above a stacked area chart of composition through time, closing on a ranked table of the largest contributors.

templates.name: Project Status Dashboard
templates.description: Status analytics mixing progress and time-axis shapes: a completion donut, a horizontal timeline of dated bars against a today marker, a per-owner table with progress and status, an at-risk list, and a burndown.

templates.name: Executive Summary Dashboard
templates.description: Report-shaped analytics with a prose rail beside the charts: a scorecard of headline numbers with period deltas and status coloring, goal-attainment bars, a trend grid, and a written commentary column that folds beneath the content when narrow.

templates.name: DateInput — Clearable
templates.description: Date input with a clear button that resets the value. Use when the date field is optional and the user may need to undo their selection.

templates.name: DateInput — Min/Max Constraints
templates.description: Date input constrained to a min/max window. Use when only certain dates are valid, like booking availability or a fiscal quarter.

templates.name: DateInput — Formats
templates.description: The format prop reuses Timestamp's format vocabulary to control how the committed value is displayed: date, date_long (default), date_weekday, and system_date, or a function for a fully custom string. Formatting applies only to the committed value, never to text the user is actively typing.

templates.name: DateInput
templates.description: A date input field with a calendar popover. Type a date or click the calendar icon to pick one.

templates.name: DateInput — Description
templates.description: Date input with helper text below the label explaining what the field expects. Use when the purpose of the date is not obvious from the label alone.

templates.name: DateInput — Validation
templates.description: Date input in all three status states: error, warning, and success. Use to surface validation issues, caution the user, or confirm a valid selection.

templates.name: DateRangeInput
templates.description: A date range picker with a button trigger and dual-month calendar popover with preset ranges.

templates.name: DateRangeInput — With Presets
templates.description: Date range picker with quick-select presets for common periods. Use for analytics dashboards, report filters, or any context where users frequently select standard time windows.

templates.name: DateRangeInput — Validation
templates.description: Date range input in all three status states: error, warning, and success. Use to surface booking conflicts, flag high-demand periods, or confirm an available range.

templates.name: DateTimeInput
templates.description: A combined date and time picker. Desktop opens a calendar popover with a time input; touch devices open a Date/Time bottom sheet.

templates.name: DateTimeInput — Validation
templates.description: DateTimeInput in all three status states: error, warning, and success. Use to surface scheduling conflicts, caution the user about edge cases, or confirm a valid datetime.

templates.name: Order Detail
templates.description: Single-record detail in two columns: a summary header with status and actions, a repeating line-item list, a totals block that sums it, and a chronological activity timeline in the rail. The shape for any record holding children plus a history: a customer order with shipping, an invoice, a transaction, or a job.

templates.name: Dialog — Adaptive presentation
templates.description: Opt-in recipe for an AdaptiveDialog wrapper: Dialog remains the default everywhere, while touchPresentation="bottom-sheet" switches only at lg and below when pointer is coarse and hover is unavailable. Includes a deterministic presentation override for tests/unusual environments and notes that BottomSheet purpose controls swipe and scrim dismissal. Usage examples: touchPresentation="dialog" keeps Dialog, "fullscreen" chooses fullscreen Dialog, and "bottom-sheet" chooses BottomSheet only for the touch-oriented range. Keep presentation as the deterministic override. Do not use this by default for AlertDialog or destructive confirmations.

templates.name: Dialog — Confirmation
templates.description: Asks the user to confirm a destructive action before it happens. Use before deleting projects, removing team members, revoking API keys, or any irreversible operation.

templates.name: Dialog — Form
templates.description: Collects user input without navigating away from the page. Uses purpose="form" so clicking the backdrop won't close it. Use for editing profiles, creating items, or updating settings inline.

templates.name: Dialog — Fullscreen
templates.description: Takes over the entire viewport for content that needs maximum space. Use for documentation viewers, rich text editors, multi-step wizards, or media previews where the standard dialog width is too narrow.

templates.name: DialogHeader — Basic
templates.description: A DialogHeader with a title, subtitle, and close button, placed in the header slot of a Dialog Layout. Pass onOpenChange to render the close button.

templates.name: DialogHeader
templates.description: DialogHeader provides a structured header for dialogs with slots for title, subtitle, close button, and optional start or end content.

templates.name: Dialog — Scrollable
templates.description: Constrains the dialog height and scrolls the body when content overflows. Use for terms and conditions, license agreements, changelogs, or any long-form content the user needs to review before accepting.

templates.name: Dialog
templates.description: Modal dialog with a header, body content, and close button.

templates.name: Dialog — Required
templates.description: Cannot be dismissed by Escape or backdrop click; the user must explicitly choose an action. Uses purpose="required". Use for ownership transfers, legal acknowledgements, or critical decisions where skipping is not an option.

templates.name: Divider — Full Bleed
templates.description: Divider that extends past container padding to span the full width. Use inside cards or panels when you want a clean edge-to-edge separation, like between an order summary and total.

templates.name: Divider — Variants
templates.description: Horizontal dividers in subtle and strong variants, plus a labeled divider. A quick visual reference for separator styles.

templates.name: Divider — Variants
templates.description: Subtle, labeled, and strong dividers in a single card. Use subtle between related sections, labeled for alternatives like "or", and strong for high-contrast boundaries.

templates.name: Divider — Vertical
templates.description: Vertical dividers separating side-by-side metrics. Use between stat cards, toolbar groups, or any horizontal layout where you need a visual boundary between sections.

templates.name: Documentation Catalog
templates.description: Reference landing that is pure wayfinding: a banner above a grid of category cards linking into sections, with no article content on the surface itself.

templates.name: Documentation Design
templates.description: Reference article alternating prose with live rendered examples: an interactive preview, a property table, paired do and don't comparisons, and copyable code blocks.

templates.name: Documentation Technical
templates.description: Reference article ordered as sequential numbered steps with code at each stage, plus callout cards for prerequisites and onward links. A linear walkthrough rather than a browsable reference.

templates.name: Edit form with footer actions
templates.description: Compose a Layout with DrawerHeader, the fields in LayoutContent, and Cancel and Save in a pinned LayoutFooter. purpose="form" keeps Escape but ignores scrim clicks, so a stray click outside does not discard edits.

templates.name: DrawerHeader
templates.description: DrawerHeader provides a structured header for drawers with slots for title, subtitle, close button, and optional start or end content.

templates.name: With subtitle and end content
templates.description: Add a subtitle under the title and put a status, such as a Badge, in endContent. The close button stays at the end of the row.

templates.name: With close button
templates.description: Pass onOpenChange to render a close button that calls it with false. Drawer renders no close button of its own, so this is the usual visible way to close.

templates.name: Modal or non-modal (hasScrim)
templates.description: The default modal drawer dims the page, traps focus, and closes on a scrim click. With hasScrim={false}, the drawer has no scrim or focus trap and leaves the page interactive.

templates.name: Basic
templates.description: Open a modal drawer from a single trigger. The scrim dims the page; Escape, a scrim click, or the header close button closes it, and focus returns to the trigger.

templates.name: Slide in from the start edge
templates.displayName: Slide in from the start edge
templates.description: Set side="start" to open from the inline start edge: left in LTR and right in RTL. The default end edge follows the inspector convention.

templates.name: Width budget: pixels or any CSS length
templates.displayName: Width budget: pixels or any CSS length
templates.description: Compare a numeric pixel width with rem and percentage lengths. The width budget also caps the drawer on mobile.

templates.name: DropdownMenu — Actions
templates.description: Action menu with dividers separating safe and destructive operations. Use for row-level actions on items like documents, projects, or records.

templates.name: DropdownMenu — Adaptive presentation
templates.description: Chooses a bottom sheet for compact touch surfaces and an anchored popover otherwise. The media query is product policy, while DropdownMenu owns both presentations.

templates.name: DropdownMenuGroup
templates.description: A compound-mode menu whose rows are titled in groups. Each DropdownMenuGroup renders a role="group" named by its heading; arrow keys and typeahead skip the heading.

templates.name: DropdownMenuGroup — Selectable rows
templates.description: Titled groups around a radio group and checkbox rows — the rows the data API cannot express, which is why the heading lives in compound mode.

templates.name: DropdownMenuItem — Basic
templates.description: Dropdown menu items with labels and secondary descriptions. Use DropdownMenuItem to render custom menu entries with consistent styling.

templates.name: DropdownMenuItem
templates.description: Dropdown menu with custom-rendered items using DropdownMenuItem for icons and descriptions.

templates.name: DropdownMenu — Icon Trigger
templates.description: Overflow menu triggered by an icon-only button with no chevron or label text. Use for row-level actions in tables, cards, or lists where a text button would take too much space.

templates.name: DropdownMenu
templates.description: A button that opens a dropdown menu with action items. The menu starts open for preview.

templates.name: DropdownMenu — Disabled
templates.description: Menu with selectively disabled items based on permissions. Use when some actions require higher privileges, like admin-only operations.

templates.name: DropdownMenu — Sections
templates.description: Menu items organized into titled sections for easy scanning. Use when you have 6+ actions that fall into distinct categories, like Create vs Manage.

templates.name: DropdownMenu — Submenu
templates.description: Action menu with a nested submenu. Hover or Right arrow opens the flyout; Left arrow / Escape closes it. Use to group related destinations or secondary actions without crowding the top level.

templates.name: Page Editor
templates.description: Three-pane authoring workspace: a source palette on one flank, a live canvas in the middle, and an inspector that retargets to whatever is selected. Drag and drop to reorder, edit to see it render immediately.

templates.name: EmptyState — Actions
templates.description: Full empty state with icon, message, and action buttons. Use when a search returns no results, a filter clears all items, or a list has been emptied. The buttons give the user a way forward: go back, clear filters, or try a different query.

templates.name: EmptyState — Compact
templates.description: Smaller empty state with reduced spacing for constrained areas. Use inside sidebar panels, card widgets, or notification drawers where a full-size empty state would overwhelm the layout.

templates.name: EmptyState — Container
templates.description: Empty state wrapped in a Card for first-time setup or onboarding. Use when the user has not created any items yet, like a project list, team roster, or dashboard widget that will fill with data once they take action.

templates.name: EmptyState
templates.description: A no-results empty state with an icon, descriptive message, and a call-to-action button.

templates.name: FieldLabel — Basic
templates.description: Standalone labels with required and optional indicators and a helper description. Use when labeling a custom control that does not render its own label.

templates.name: FieldLabel
templates.description: Standalone field labels demonstrating required, optional, tooltip, and icon variations.

templates.name: Field — Required & Optional
templates.description: Required and optional field indicators side by side. Use isRequired on fields the user must fill in, and isOptional to clarify which fields can be skipped.

templates.name: Field
templates.description: A form field wrapping a text input with a label, description, and validation status.

templates.name: FieldStatus — Basic
templates.description: Detached error and success messages for validation feedback. Use below checkboxes, switches, or custom controls where an attached status would overlap.

templates.name: FieldStatus
templates.description: Field status messages in error, warning, and success states with attached and detached variants.

templates.name: Field — Validation States
templates.description: All three validation states: error, warning, and success. Use error for invalid input, warning for potential issues like reserved names, and success to confirm valid entries like API keys.

templates.name: Field — Description
templates.description: Fields with helper text below the label. Use descriptions to explain format requirements, constraints, or what happens with the data, like "At least 8 characters" or "We will send a confirmation link".

templates.name: File Explorer
templates.description: Hierarchical browser that drills through nested levels as adjacent columns rather than replacing the list each time, with breadcrumb history, switchable list and grid density, and a metadata pane for the selected node.

templates.name: FileInput — Basic
templates.description: A controlled single-file upload with accepted types, a size limit, and helper text. Use for standard document upload fields in forms.

templates.name: Two-column Form
templates.description: Form split into two columns beneath a hero header: inputs on one flank, a persistent context panel opposite that stays put while the fields scroll. Flat, single submit, no steps.

templates.name: Form Wizard
templates.description: Linear multi-step form that moves through one panel at a time, with a horizontal progress track pinned above rather than running down a rail, so every step keeps the full content width for its fields. Only the current step renders, unlike an accordion where each section expands into one long scrolling form. Each advance is validated, and a step left broken stays flagged to jump back to.

templates.name: Dialog Wizard
templates.description: Step through a short flow in a dialog, overlay, or popup launched from the page underneath, which stays where it was. Compact step markers and a pinned action row inside a constrained width, rather than the full page a wizard usually gets. Best for two to four short steps — setup, invite, schedule, onboarding — where losing the context underneath would cost more than the flow is worth.

templates.name: Inline Wizard
templates.description: Accordion wizard stacking every step in one column: the active step expands in place while finished ones collapse to a single line carrying their result and a way back in. Steps that run themselves expand into a nested stepper that ticks check by check and halts the column where one fails. Best when later steps depend on what earlier ones decided.

templates.name: Vertical Wizard
templates.description: Multi-step wizard with the steps in a fixed left rail that stays visible while the form scrolls, plus a side panel whose guidance follows the focused field. Suits long or unequal steps carrying uploads, previews, and dense review metadata. As width tightens the guidance drops first, then the rail rotates into a horizontal stepper above the form.

templates.name: FormLayout — Horizontal
templates.description: Two fields side by side for naturally paired inputs like first and last name

templates.name: FormLayout — Settings Form
templates.description: Settings form with labels placed beside their inputs

templates.name: FormLayout — Mixed Controls
templates.description: Form with different control types: text input, selector, and checkboxes

templates.name: FormLayout — Nested Address Form
templates.description: Address form mixing vertical and horizontal layouts for grouped fields

templates.name: FormLayout
templates.description: A vertical form layout with text input fields.

templates.name: Gallery Hero
templates.description: Centered stack (headline, short blurb, call-to-action buttons) resolving into a multi-image photo grid rather than one wide full-bleed picture, so the imagery reads as a set.

templates.name: Grid — Dashboard Layout
templates.description: Dashboard layout with mixed-size widgets and a full-width summary row

templates.name: Grid — Card Gallery
templates.description: Card gallery with responsive columns that maintain consistent widths

templates.name: Grid — Responsive Auto-Fit
templates.description: Responsive grid where cards stretch to fill remaining space

templates.name: GridSpan — Columns
templates.description: Grid items spanning two of three columns. Wrap a grid child in GridSpan to make it occupy multiple columns for asymmetric layouts.

templates.name: GridSpan
templates.description: GridSpan lets a grid item span multiple columns or rows within an Grid, enabling masonry-style and asymmetric layouts.

templates.name: Grid — Column Spanning
templates.description: Grid with featured items spanning multiple columns and rows

templates.name: Heading — Card Grid
templates.description: Responsive card grid with truncated headings and descriptions for uniform layout

templates.name: Heading — Page Hierarchy
templates.description: Real-world page layout demonstrating heading levels h1 through h3 with supporting text

templates.name: Heading — Truncation
templates.description: Single-line and multi-line heading truncation with ellipsis for constrained layouts

templates.name: useHoverCard — Profile Preview
templates.description: Custom profile preview using useHoverCard with direct trigger and render control.

templates.name: HoverCard — Definition
templates.description: Shows a term definition on hover within a paragraph. Use for technical terms, jargon, or concepts that some readers may not know, like a glossary built into the text.

templates.name: HoverCard — Link Preview
templates.description: Shows a page summary when hovering a link: title, description, and URL. Use for documentation links, article references, or any URL where a preview helps the user decide whether to click.

templates.name: HoverCard — Profile Preview
templates.description: Shows a user profile summary on hover with name, role, and bio. Use on usernames, avatars, or mentions to let users preview a profile without navigating away.

templates.name: HoverCard
templates.description: A hover card that shows a user profile preview when hovering over a trigger button. Starts open for preview.

templates.name: HStack — Basic
templates.description: Items arranged in a horizontal row with a consistent gap and centered vertical alignment. Use HStack whenever siblings should sit side by side.

templates.name: HStack
templates.description: Demonstrates HStack arranging items horizontally with different gaps and alignments.

templates.name: IconButton — Action Bar
templates.description: Row of ghost icon buttons for a compact action toolbar

templates.name: IconButton — Floating
templates.description: A floating action button (FAB). The most common floating-button shape is icon-only. Raised here with `elevation="high"`.

templates.name: IconButton — Loading State
templates.description: Icon buttons that show a loading spinner on click for async feedback

templates.name: IconButton
templates.description: An icon button with a wrench icon.

templates.name: IconButton — With Tooltips
templates.description: Icon buttons with tooltips that explain each action on hover

templates.name: Icon — Non-Semantic Colors
templates.description: Non-semantic color palette for icons.

templates.name: Icon — Semantic Colors
templates.description: All semantic icon color variants with labels.

templates.name: Icon — Size Variants
templates.description: All icon sizes from extra-small to large.

templates.name: Icon — Status Indicators
templates.description: Status list using semantic icons for success, warning, error, and info.

templates.name: IDE
templates.description: Dense multi-pane workspace of resizable, collapsible regions: a hierarchy tree on one flank, tabbed documents in the middle, a docked drawer along the bottom, an inspector opposite. Drag a divider to resize or collapse any of them.

templates.name: Incident Console
templates.description: Dense row queue with an inspector: severity-coded rows grouped by status, a saved-search filter bar, a segmented status control, and a resizable detail pane for the selected row. Rows, not cards, sized for scanning volume.

templates.name: InputGroup — Basic
templates.description: A currency field with static prefix and suffix addons around a TextInput. Use InputGroupText to clarify units or input format.

templates.name: InternationalizationProvider — Shipped Locale
templates.description: Load a locale catalog shipped by Astryx and re-render InternationalizationProvider with a new locale to update Astryx strings live.

templates.name: InternationalizationProvider — Overrides
templates.description: Override a small number of Astryx strings without providing a full locale catalog.

templates.name: InternationalizationProvider — RTL Direction
templates.description: Toggle text direction with the `dir` prop and watch Astryx components mirror. Pagination flips its prev/next chevrons under RTL. The `dir` prop is passed to both `InternationalizationProvider` (so Astryx components pick it up) and the `VStack` (so the DOM subtree mirrors); both channels stay in sync with no extra wrapper.

templates.name: Item — Basic
templates.description: A basic item with a label, supporting description, and end-aligned timestamp. Use this for simple rows that need consistent text alignment and spacing.

templates.name: Item — Document Tabs
templates.description: Single-row, horizontally scrollable document switcher with compact selected rows, leading file icons, instant reveal-on-hover close actions with reserved geometry, stable separators, and an add control outside the scroll area. Use for editor tabs, workspace tabs, open documents, files, canvases, or panels.

templates.name: Item — Start Content
templates.description: Items with leading avatars and icons in the startContent slot. Keep start content small so the row stays compact and easy to scan.

templates.name: Item — Metadata
templates.description: Status rows with an icon, a title, a short description, and end-aligned metadata such as a timestamp or a status badge, here build, memory, and sync events. Use the endContent slot for counts, status, timestamps, and other secondary row information.

templates.name: Kanban Board
templates.description: Horizontal lanes of draggable cards where the column itself is the status, so drag and drop between lanes is the state change. Fixed columns, variable-height cards.

templates.name: Kbd — Inline Instructions
templates.description: Keyboard shortcuts rendered inline within instructional text

templates.name: Kbd — Menu Shortcuts
templates.description: Menu-style list pairing action labels with their keyboard shortcuts

templates.name: Kbd — Modifier Combinations
templates.description: Modifier combinations and special keys rendered as shortcut badges

templates.name: useLayer — Anchored Layer
templates.description: Low-level anchored overlay rendered with useLayer and a custom surface.

templates.name: Layout — Basic Card
templates.description: A card layout with header, scrollable content area, and footer with action buttons.

templates.name: LayoutContent — Basic
templates.description: A scrollable main content area below a fixed header. Use LayoutContent inside Layout to get automatic padding and scroll containment for the primary content.

templates.name: Layout — Content Only
templates.description: A minimal layout with just a content area inside a card, without header or footer.

templates.name: LayoutContent
templates.description: LayoutContent is the scrollable main content area within a Layout, providing automatic padding and scroll containment between the header and footer.

templates.name: Layout — Content Width
templates.description: A layout using contentWidth to constrain and center content while keeping dividers full-bleed.

templates.name: Layout — Dual Panel
templates.description: A file browser style layout with start panel for folders, main content for files, and end panel for details.

templates.name: LayoutFooter — Actions
templates.description: A fixed footer with end-aligned action buttons below scrollable content. Use LayoutFooter inside Layout for persistent actions like Save and Cancel.

templates.name: LayoutFooter
templates.description: LayoutFooter is a fixed footer slot within a Layout, pinned to the bottom for persistent actions like form buttons or navigation.

templates.name: Layout — Full Bleed Content
templates.description: A layout where content extends edge-to-edge with zero padding, ideal for tables or images.

templates.name: LayoutHeader
templates.description: LayoutHeader is a fixed header slot within a Layout, pinned to the top for titles, navigation, and action buttons.

templates.name: LayoutHeader — With Actions
templates.description: A fixed page header with a title and a primary action, above scrollable content. Use LayoutHeader inside Layout for persistent page-level headers.

templates.name: LayoutPanel — Navigation
templates.description: A fixed-width side panel holding a navigation list next to the main content. Use LayoutPanel in the start or end slot of Layout for sidebars.

templates.name: LayoutPanel
templates.description: LayoutPanel is a sidebar slot within a Layout, used for navigation, detail views, or secondary content alongside the main content area.

templates.name: Layout — Sidebar Navigation
templates.description: A settings page layout with a navigation sidebar panel, content area, header, and footer.

templates.name: Card Grid
templates.description: Searchable, browsable card grid with filter tabs and a real empty state: uniform tiles organized by topic, narrowing in place, with no detail surface behind them.

templates.name: Lightbox — Gallery
templates.description: A thumbnail grid that opens a fullscreen gallery. Clicking any thumbnail opens the lightbox at that index. Prev/next navigation lets users browse all images without closing.

templates.name: Lightbox
templates.description: A fullscreen image viewer with caption.

templates.name: Lightbox — Video
templates.description: Opens a video in the lightbox. Native browser controls are available. Zoom and pan are disabled for video items.

templates.name: Lightbox — Zoom
templates.description: A lightbox with zoom and pan enabled. Double-click the image to zoom in; drag to pan around. Double-click again or use the close button to exit.

templates.name: Link — External Links
templates.description: A vertical list of external links that open in a new tab with an indicator icon.

templates.name: Link — Inline Text
templates.description: A link embedded within a paragraph of body text.

templates.name: Link Provider — Custom Link Component
templates.description: Routes every Astryx link through a custom component that intercepts the click, the hook frameworks like Next.js use for client-side navigation. Click the link to see the custom handler fire instead of a full-page load.

templates.name: Link
templates.description: A standalone link.

templates.name: Link — With Tooltips
templates.description: Horizontal row of standalone links with descriptive hover tooltips.

templates.name: List — Basic
templates.description: Simple list with labels and descriptions for settings-style layouts.

templates.name: List — Bulleted Features
templates.description: Bulleted list of feature highlights using disc markers.

templates.name: List Item — Basic
templates.description: Basic list items with labels and descriptions. Use this structure for settings, navigation summaries, and other simple collections.

templates.name: ListItem
templates.description: List items with icons, descriptions, and end content slots demonstrating the full ListItem API.

templates.name: List Item — Media
templates.description: List items with leading avatars and icons. Use startContent for compact visual identifiers that help users scan the collection.

templates.name: List Item — Metadata
templates.description: List items with end-aligned metadata. Use endContent for badges, counts, timestamps, and compact status details.

templates.name: List — Message List
templates.description: Chat-style message list with avatars, preview text, and unread badges.

templates.name: List — Ordered Steps
templates.description: Numbered step-by-step instructions using decimal list markers.

templates.name: Basic Login
templates.description: Minimal centered credential form on a plain ground: two fields and a submit, nothing competing for attention. The least-chrome entry surface.

templates.name: Login Card
templates.description: Credential form inside an elevated centered card, third-party provider buttons separated from the fields by a divider, secondary sign-up and legal links beneath.

templates.name: Login Split
templates.description: Credential form filling one half of a two-pane split, full-bleed media holding the other. Same fields as the card variant, but the layout carries brand imagery.

templates.name: Login SSO
templates.description: Progressive credential flow that branches on input: the email domain resolves an identity provider and redirects, with a password path as fallback. Two-stage rather than one form.

templates.name: Markdown — Cited Content
templates.description: Markdown with citation chips linked to external sources

templates.name: Markdown — Compact AI Response
templates.description: Compact markdown styled for AI responses with shifted heading levels

templates.name: Markdown — Data Table
templates.description: Comparison table rendered from a markdown string

templates.name: Markdown — Rich Content
templates.description: Markdown with headings, lists, code blocks, tables, blockquotes, and task lists

templates.name: Markdown
templates.description: Rich markdown content with headings, lists, and formatting.

templates.name: MediaTheme — Image Overlay
templates.description: A common image card pattern: place text and actions over a dark gradient and wrap the overlay content in MediaTheme mode="dark".

templates.name: MediaTheme — Light Scrim
templates.description: A light scrim over an image. Use MediaTheme mode="light" so text and ghost buttons use dark-on-light tokens.

templates.name: MediaTheme — Media Overlay
templates.description: A compact media overlay showing MediaTheme adapting text, icons, badges, and button variants over an image-backed dark surface.

templates.name: Messaging Shell
templates.description: Four-column nested navigation narrowing left to right (team workspace, channel list, message stream, thread panel) where each column scopes the next. Dense rows, zero cards.

templates.name: MetadataList — Basic
templates.description: Single-column key-value metadata list.

templates.name: MetadataList — Collapsible

templates.name: MetadataList — Horizontal
templates.description: Horizontal metadata items for compact inline display.

templates.name: MetadataListItem — Basic
templates.description: A titled section of label and value rows for one record, here a deployment's environment, health status badge, version, and last deploy date. Values take plain text or a component such as a Badge.

templates.name: MetadataListItem
templates.description: Metadata list items displaying labeled values in various formats including text, badges, and links.

templates.name: MetadataList — Multi-Column

templates.name: Mixed Gallery

templates.name: MobileNav — Basic Drawer

templates.name: MobileNav — Without Title

templates.description: Basic three-dot overflow menu with simple text-only action items.

templates.description: A basic three-dot menu with simple action items.

templates.name: MultiSelector — Bottom Sheet
templates.description: Keeps a multi-selection list open in a bottom sheet while choices are toggled.

templates.name: MultiSelector — Column Visibility
templates.description: Column visibility toggle with hidden label, search, select-all, and selection count.

templates.name: MultiSelector — Ghost Toolbar
templates.description: Borderless MultiSelector variant composed with ghost buttons in a toolbar.

templates.name: MultiSelector — Searchable
templates.description: Multi-select with search filtering and select-all.

templates.name: MultiSelector — Sectioned Permissions
templates.description: Multi-select with options grouped into labeled sections.

templates.name: NavHeadingMenu

templates.description: Circular icon containers for navigation headers with accent backgrounds.

templates.name: NumberInput — Clearable
templates.description: Number input with a clear button, unit suffix, and min/max constraint

templates.name: NumberInput — Range Constrained
templates.description: Number input with min/max boundaries and a helper description

templates.name: NumberInput
templates.description: A number input for quantity entry.

templates.name: NumberInput — Status Variants
templates.description: Number inputs showing error, warning, and success validation states

templates.name: NumberInput — With Units
templates.description: Number input with a percentage unit suffix and valid range

templates.name: OverflowList
templates.description: A list of buttons that collapses overflowing items into a +N indicator.

templates.description: Places compact supporting content in a bottom scrim strip without covering the entire image.

templates.name: Overlay — Hover Reveal
templates.description: Reveals an overlay action on hover or keyboard focus. Use when actions should stay visually quiet until the media receives attention.

templates.name: Overlay
templates.description: A media card with an always-visible scrim and centered action content.

templates.description: Pagination below a data table with client-side page slicing. Use the count variant with small size for dense data views where users need to see item ranges.

templates.name: Checkout Form
templates.description: Long sectioned form running beside a summary that stays visible while the fields scroll and recalculates as they change, ending on a terminal confirm of the total. Sections run contact, address, delivery choice, then card details.

templates.name: Popover — Bottom Sheet Alternative
